_comment: What an inflicted tempest costs an Age's instability budget, dial by dial (design 5.0, 5.2).
Difficulty you can answer: a lightning rod grounds any bolt within its reach and nothing here changes
that, so copper on the roof is the whole answer whatever was bought. `often` (how often bolts come) is
cheap; `blast` (how big a crater one digs) and `fire` (how much it sets alight) are dear. Opens at 16
with the other phenomena. The numbers wait on the tuning pass.
